en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional haiduk-type song; 'биро' is my reading as 'bailiff/officer' (guess). 'вршник да гори' is my reading: probably 'to tend the fire' or burn something for the roast; uncertain.

lines.cyr: Многу сам гори прошетал, биро бре,
lines.lat: Mnogu sam gori prošetal, biro bre,
lines.en: I have wandered many forests, hey, bailiff,
most of all the Pirin mountain.

lines.cyr: Многу сам мајки расплакал, биро бре,
lines.lat: Mnogu sam majki rasplakal, biro bre,
lines.en: I have made many mothers weep, hey, bailiff,

lines.cyr: Наредба сум му прочитал, биро бре,
lines.lat: Naredba sum mu pročital, biro bre,
lines.en: I read him the order, hey, bailiff,

lines.cyr: Татко му сум го наредил, биро бре,
lines.lat: Tatko mu sum go naredil, biro bre,
lines.en: I ordered his father, hey, bailiff,

lines.cyr: Мајка му сум ја наредил, биро бре,
lines.lat: Majka mu sum ja naredil, biro bre,
lines.en: I ordered his mother, hey, bailiff,
to burn the spit for Asan.

lines.cyr: Браќа му сум ги наредил, биро бре,
lines.lat: Braḱa mu sum gi naredil, biro bre,
lines.en: I ordered his brothers, hey, bailiff,
to play the flute for Asan.

lines.cyr: Сестри му сум ги наредил, биро бре,
lines.lat: Sestri mu sum gi naredil, biro bre,
lines.en: I ordered his sisters, hey, bailiff,
to dance the oro for Asan.
